sloka: पंच दास्यः सहस्राणि सर्व आभरण भूषिताः ।सीते परिचरिष्यन्ति भार्या भवसि मे यदि ॥३-४७-३१॥
transliteration: paṁca dāsyaḥ sahasrāṇi sarva ābharaṇa bhūṣitāḥ ।sīte paricariṣyanti bhāryā bhavasi me yadi ॥3-47-31॥

translations.english: O Sita if you become my wife, five thousand female attendants adorned with all ornaments will attend on you.
